name: Early Risers - As Bill Sees It
Tuesday Night Tea Club
location: Mustangs for Recovery at Cal Poly
notes:
Tuesday Night Tea Club is a closed recovery meeting for students and community members that are currently sober and on a path of recovery. Join students with diverse backgrounds, sobriety lengths, and experience with maintaining sobriety while attending university. Discuss current stressors, learn more about the key tenets of paths to recovery including Alcoholics Anonymous, Narcotics Anonymous, and other recovery philosophies. Build community with your fellow students in recovery.
All Meetings Are Anonymous. Individuals in attendance will be expected to follow community guidelines and respect each individual and their experience.
